lyrics:
[Intro: organ swell, marching snare, a room murmuring]

[Chorus: male voice rough, choir behind]
It's day one again
I know this room, I know that door
It's day one again
And I've stood up here before
Count me from today
I'm not ashamed to start
Day one again
Hand me the chip, I know my part

[Verse 1: male rap, plain and direct]
First time I got ninety days, I framed it
Second time, six months, and then I stained it
Told myself one wouldn't hurt, I'd earned it
One turned into a week before I learned it
Wife took the kids to her mother's in the spring
I don't blame her. I'd have done the same thing.
So here's the folding chair, the coffee, and the creed
A stranger nods at me like he knows what I need

[Chorus: male voice rough, choir behind]
It's day one again
I know this room, I know that door
It's day one again
And I've stood up here before
Count me from today
I'm not ashamed to start
Day one again
Hand me the chip, I know my part

[Verse 2: rap, more force, strings rising]
They say the opposite of using ain't just quitting
It's the phone calls, and the showing up, and sitting
With the boredom and the shame and the receipt
For every dinner missed and every lie you had to keep
I ain't here because I'm strong. I'm here because I'm through.
If you're listening in your car and this is you
Park it. Come inside. There's a chair.
Nobody in this basement's gonna stare.

[Bridge: choir alone, then the room speaking]
They won again? No.
Day one again.
(Hi. Welcome back.)

[Final Chorus: full choir, drums marching, voice breaking]
It's day one again
I know this room, I know that door
It's day one again
And I've stood up here before
Count me from today
I'm not ashamed to start
Day one again
Hand me the chip, I know my part

[Outro: organ, chairs scraping, quiet applause]
producerBrief:
TEMPO / KEY / FEEL: 86 BPM, 4/4, C minor. A slow, heavy march that builds into an anthem.

VOICE: Male. The verses are rapped plainly and seriously, with no tricks. The chorus is sung in a rough, strained chest voice with a mixed gospel choir behind it. A small crowd speaks one line of welcome in the bridge.

INSTRUMENTS: A church organ, marching snare rolls over a deep kick, a low piano, a string section, a mixed choir, a sub bass, handclaps on the last chorus.

ARRANGEMENT MAP: 0:00 Intro, organ and snare. 0:14 Chorus 1. 0:46 Verse 1. 1:30 Chorus 2. 2:02 Verse 2. 2:46 Bridge, choir and the room. 3:02 Final chorus. 3:34 Outro, chairs and applause, ends 3:48.

PRODUCTION & MIX: 2010 arena hip-hop: huge drums, wide choir and strings, vocal dry and up front.

SIGNATURE MOMENT: The room's '(Hi. Welcome back.)' at 2:58.

MODERN POINT OF VIEW: The original is a first declaration. Most people who get sober declare it more than once, and this song is for the second, third and fourth time.

EMOTIONAL ARC: Ashamed, honest, inviting, welcomed.
